0x00375E.en: 「Come on, don't just stand there gawking!!」

0x0037F1.en: 「Get in my way and I won't hold back!」

0x00381F.en: 「Now, feel the power of the/ Valsione for yourself!」

0x0038A6.en: 「I'll show you what I can do!」

0x0038D4.en: 「In the end,/ you just couldn't rein in your own ambition!/ Get ready, Kirkus!」

0x003952.en: 「Kirkus!/ I'll never accept the way you do things!」

0x0039AB.en: 「Clinging to power by any means....../ It's pathetic, Kirkus!」

0x003A13.en: 「Whoa, what is that thing!?/ Fighting it head-on is pointless!」

0x003A75.en: 「They say you can't damage it, but/ if I hit at max output......」

0x003AD7.en: 「Guys like him,/ I just can't stand......he makes my skin crawl!」

0x003B39.en: 「Amnesia, my foot!/ This isn't a comic book, who'd believe that!」

0x003B9B.en: 「Sure, I'll admit your vibe's/ changed a little bit./ But I won't let you off!」

0x003C22.en: 「Ugh......fighting that guy/ just feels wrong to me......」

0x003C78.en: 「You're Shu's lackey!/ I can't just let you slip by!」

0x003CD1.en: 「Heh....../ Looks like you might actually put up a fight./ How fun!」

0x003D3D.en: 「I see,/ that guy's no ordinary small fry./ I'd better stay sharp!」

0x003DB2.en: 「Nice moves you've got./ Ex-special forces, maybe?」

0x003E7C.en: 「Duvan!/ I won't let you gain any more power!」

0x003EFA.en: 「Melior Esse...... looks like a real fight!」

0x003F3D.en: 「Melior Esse, huh. I'll stay on my guard!」

0x003F80.en: 「Wipe that grin off your face, Contagio!」

0x003FC3.en: 「Aquila! I won't lose a power contest!」

0x003FFD.en: 「Perfectio! Go back to the world you came from!」

0x004040.en: 「Freki! You're taking me on, like it or not!」

0x00407A.en: 「You lot are the ones who/ started this fight in the first place!」

0x00412C.en: 「In the end,/ that ambition was too big for you!」

0x004206.en: 「Guang Long! I'll drag you down from there!」

0x0042B7.en: 「Gaia Sabers,/ I can't accept the way you operate!」

0x004310.en: 「In a way, they're worse than the DC!」

0x004350.en: 「Dress it up all you want, a Valsion's/ still an old model to me!」

0x0043C4.en: 「Never thought I'd end up/ fighting a Valsion in a place like this......」

0x00441D.en: 「Perfect timing./ Valsion or Valsione,/ I'll settle which one's on top!」

0x0044B3.en: 「Ugh, this is creepy....../ Destruction god or not,/ it's just a monster.」

0x004534.en: 「Honestly,/ what part of that monster is a god!」

0x004587.en: 「I don't really believe in gods/ myself, but....../ that thing's got no business being worshipped as one!」

0x00461D.en: 「Gan Eden!/ I've no intention of being protected by you!」

0x0046FA.en: 「I won't let you evolve any further!」

0x004731.en: 「A rematch, huh./ But I'll turn the tables on you!」

0x004781.en: 「That thing/ makes my skin crawl, but....../ no time to be picky now!」

0x004909.en: 「I'll slap that smirk off your face!」

0x004980.en: 「I won't let the Ruina do as they please!」

0x0049EE.en: 「Enough already,/ why don't you just give up on Earth!」

0x004A38.en: 「I'll make you meet the same fate/ as the Inspectors!」

0x004A82.en: 「Don't lay a hand on our planet!」

0x004ABF.en: 「That kind of thing isn't my strong suit......」

0x004B30.en: 「Geez, whose taste is that supposed to be!」

0x004B64.en: 「First, I've got to stop that machine!」

0x004B92.en: 「Hit me and I'll hit you back!!」

0x004BC0.en: 「As if I'd let you do as you please!」

0x004C32.en: 「I'm not letting you go home for free!!」

0x004C97.en: 「I can't just let you off the hook!」

0x004DCF.en: 「No way!? The Valsione's being pushed back!?」

0x004E12.en: 「A-at this rate,/ even the Valsione might not hold out......」

0x004F0B.en: 「I-I think I took a bit too much......」

0x004F7C.en: 「Guh!! I might be in real trouble here.」

0x004FB9.en: 「Y-you're really giving it to me,/ old man Kirkus!」

0x00500C.en: 「Agh!/ Th-this attack hits hard, physically/ and mentally......」

0x005072.en: 「I-I see....../ so this is you getting serious!」

0x00510C.en: 「Guh!!/ Guess it really lives up to being/ called a destruction god......」

0x0051DD.en: 「Ow!! Why you, you're gonna pay for that!」

0x005254.en: 「Ow...! But that/　doesn't mean I'm done yet!!」

0x0052DB.en: 「Not yet!/　Valsione won't go down that easily!」

0x005454.en: 「Not bad, old man!/　But this won't take me down!」

0x0054FC.en: 「Not bad, Shu!/　But Valsione's true power/　starts now!」

0x005574.en: 「Tch, bad taste, but/　the skill's the real deal.」

0x0055FE.en: 「Zebris... so you can pull your weight!」

0x00572A.en: 「Ngh! Zezernan, I won't lose to you!」

0x0057B0.en: 「Ngh! To the Gaia Sabers, no less!」

0x00582A.en: 「Ngh, just as it looks,/　that thing's got serious power!」

0x0058B1.en: 「Kwaah! So this is the Four Fiends' power...!」

0x0058F1.en: 「I-if I let my guard down and get close, I'll be absorbed...!」

0x005934.en: 「Ngh! So this is Gan Eden's power...!!」

0x0059E8.en: 「Ruina.../　I can't just let them run wild...!」

0x005C0B.en: 「What was that? Are you even serious?」

0x005C3C.en: 「Hmph, that won't make/　Valsione even flinch!」

0x005C95.en: 「All that big talk, and/　you're nothing much, Kirkus!」

0x005CE5.en: 「The damage is nothing, but.../　something feels creepy.」

0x005D35.en: 「What was that?/　Hold back and you'll regret it, Shu!」

0x005E71.en: 「Getting attacked in that tone/　makes this awkward...」

0x005EC1.en: 「Hmph, you call it Duraxil,/　but it's nothing much.」

0x005F48.en: 「The speed's impressive, but.../　that's all the power you've got!」

0x005F9E.en: 「I'd rather not see a Yokijin up close...!」

0x006000.en: 「As if you could keep up with Valsione!」

0x0060F3.en: 「Not bad, but you picked the wrong foe!」

0x006130.en: 「Whoa! That hit of yours looks nasty.」

0x00623E.en: 「At this rate, you're worse than the Inspectors.」

0x006337.en: 「What do you plan to ruin with that!」

0x00639F.en: 「Looks like you didn't grow up right!」

0x0063F5.en: 「I've no taste for playing with monsters!」

0x00651F.en: 「Heh, I'm pretty proud of my reflexes~」

0x00655C.en: 「You're looking at the wrong spot,/　old man!」

0x0065A6.en: 「Ugh....../　this guy's attacks are gonna mess with my head.」

0x00663F.en: 「Even Duraxil's just a puppet/　if you can't handle it!」

0x00668C.en: 「A body that big/　can't turn on a dime!」

0x006716.en: 「Great attack, but no use if it can't hit!」

0x006759.en: 「How does that thing work?/　Not that I want the details.」

0x0067AC.en: 「Get absorbed by that and you'll never rest.」

0x0067EF.en: 「I'd rather not get a good look at that.」

0x00682F.en: 「Fast, I'll give you that!/　But I'm not losing either!」

0x00688E.en: 「In the end, you're just a fake god!」

0x006A14.en: 「Come on, Masaki! What are you doing!」

0x006AFD.en: 「Honestly....../　I really don't want to have to help you.」

0x006CC0.en: 「Ibis! Let's team up, you and me!」

0x006CFD.en: 「Arado! Now I've got to clean up your mess!?」

0x006E4C.en: 「Haha,/ not like Yang Long to let one get away./ Guess I'll finish it myself!」

0x006EBE.en: 「OK! Mio, I'll take it from here!」

0x006EF8.en: 「Yeah, not bad for Xenia./ Now let me finish this off.」

0x006F82.en: 「Gennacy, just leave the rest to me!」

0x006FB6.en: 「What are you doing, Saphine./ Someone's got to clean up after you.」

0x0074F6.en: 「Ugh,/ having to protect you of all people...」

0x007543.en: 「Saphine,/ you're not doing this on purpose, right?」

0x0075E6.en: 「I'm not about to let that slide!」

0x007814.en: 「Guess you've gone and made me serious!?」

0x00784B.en: 「My body is iron, my heart is void...」

0x0078E1.en: 「By the moonlight upon my face,/ this is the last sight you'll ever see.」

0x007C53.en: 「This one's/ no ordinary missile, in more ways than one!」
